descriptions.w3d_null_get_class: Returns the Null class record, which also lists live Null objects.
descriptions.w3d_null_unlink: Removes a Null object from its class list and decrements the live count.
descriptions.w3d_null_create: Allocates and constructs a Null object and registers it in its class list.
descriptions.w3d_null_interfaces: Returns the Null class's interface table used by interface queries.
descriptions.w3d_null_release: Drops one reference; on the last one unlinks and deletes the object. Returns the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_null_add_ref: Adds one reference and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_null_query_interface: Looks up a requested interface on a Null object through its interface table.
descriptions.w3d_null_construct: Constructs a Null object on top of the base descriptor and counts live instances.
descriptions.w3d_null_load: Loads a Null object's name and two setting bytes from a source record and clears its override flag.
descriptions.w3d_null_copy_mode: Copies the mode byte from another looked-up Null object and marks the mode as overridden.
descriptions.w3d_null_destruct: Destroys a Null object: restores its vtable, decrements the live count and runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_null_set_override: Sets the Null object's override flag and returns success.
descriptions.w3d_null_check_override: Returns success when the override flag is set, otherwise a failure status.
descriptions.w3d_null_clear_override: Clears the Null object's override flag and returns success.
descriptions.w3d_null_pool_size: Returns the number of slots in the XNullInstance pool.
descriptions.w3d_null_pool_used: Returns how many XNullInstance pool slots are in use (size minus free count).
descriptions.w3d_null_find_instance: Returns the pool index of the first in-use XNullInstance with the given key, or -1.
descriptions.w3d_null_next_instance: Advances a cursor to the next in-use XNullInstance with the given key; sets -1 at the end.
descriptions.w3d_null_method_801904c0: Forwards to the base descriptor implementation of a virtual method.
descriptions.w3d_null_method_80190538: Forwards to the base descriptor implementation of another virtual method.
descriptions.w3d_null_type_id: Returns the Null descriptor type id 6.
descriptions.w3d_null_instance_construct: Constructs an XNullInstance on the base component and counts live instances.
descriptions.w3d_null_instance_destruct: Destroys an XNullInstance: restores its vtable, decrements the count and runs the base destructor.
